ORB-11041's [far-field fixture](../../../orrery/lab/sims/level-core-far-field-slot-coefficients/) found no converged scaling regime and hence no extractable α₁ proxy or wall contact; the spin sector still needs a rotating-source apparatus to test the sourced Lense–Thirring magnitude, 1/r³ falloff, and spin-source character
legacy.kill: A surviving translational far-field g₀ᵢ slot coefficient beyond the α₁ wall, or — once a rotating-source apparatus exists — a spin sector failing Ω_LT's magnitude, 1/r³ falloff, or spin-source character where GP-B/LARES measure it
